info.title: ThreatReady InterviewPrep API
info.description: Generated from Zod schemas in packages/contracts. Do not edit openapi.json by hand.

post.summary: Create a document and a presigned upload into quarantine

get.summary: The caller's resumes and job descriptions, newest first (no text); for review and deletion

post.summary: Create a job description from pasted text
Confirm the browser finished uploading; queues extraction

get.summary: Document status and redacted extracted text

delete.summary: Delete a document, its file and its extracted text; profiles derived from it are reduced to skill ids and levels

patch.summary: Correct extraction errors in the text

post.summary: Create a session; queues resume and JD analysis

get.summary: Session state, progress, timer and transcript (refresh recovery)
SSE stream of session state changes (analysis and report jobs)

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each data line is a TurnStreamEvent

get.summary: Extracted profiles and recommended settings for confirmation

post.summary: Confirm details and configuration; builds the plan
Start the interview; streams the first question

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each data line is a TurnStreamEvent

post.summary: Recover an interrupted question stream

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each data line is a TurnStreamEvent

post.summary: Submit an answer; streams evaluation status and the next question

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each data line is a TurnStreamEvent

post.summary: Ask the interviewer a clarifying question about the current question; streams the reply

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each data line is a TurnStreamEvent

post.summary: Pause the interview timer; the question is hidden until resume, and pauses are counted in the report
Resume a paused interview
Record that the candidate left the interview tab (counted in the report; never affects the score)
End the interview and queue the report
Cancel a session that has not started
Re-queue a failed report job (idempotent)

get.summary: Short-lived download link for the report PDF
The 3D interviewer model, AES-GCM encrypted per response (key and IV in X-Asset-Key / X-Asset-Iv); never cached. The licence forbids making it publicly downloadable.
Every ThreatReady app (names, URLs, status) for the shared header
The signed-in ThreatReady user (identity from onboard.threatready.io)
Every Attack Reasoning domain with availability and the user's statistics

post.summary: Start the next attempt in a domain at a difficulty: serves a random pool question this learner has never seen (instant); generates one only when the pool has none left for them
Pool status for a domain and difficulty: ready questions this learner has not seen; asks for a background refill when it runs low (polled, so rate-limited as a read)
Skip an unanswered scenario

get.summary: The attempt: scenario, diagram, question and options (never the answer key)
SSE stream of attempt state changes while generation or evaluation runs

post.summary: Submit the selected option and the written justification; queues evaluation
Re-queue a failed generation or evaluation (idempotent)

get.summary: Score breakdown and feedback once evaluated
Attack Reasoning progress and performance analytics
